query:
SELECT state_code, district, candidate1_name, candidate1_vote_pct, candidate2_name, candidate2_vote_pct, pct_reporting, primary_winner, primary_party, status
FROM house_races
WHERE state_code IN ('KY', 'OR')
ORDER BY state_code, district;

SELECT state_code, candidate1_name, candidate1_vote_pct, candidate2_name, candidate2_vote_pct, pct_reporting, primary_winner, primary_party, status
FROM senate_races
WHERE state_code IN ('KY', 'OR');
